newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen Airways service employees end strike.
newsitem.headline: Yemen Airways service employees end strike.

text.p: Yemen Airways ground service employees ended a three-day strike on Thursday night after the airline agreed to meet one of their demands, airport officials said on Friday.
They said the strike, which cost the company more than $100,000, also affected other Arab and European arlines which were forced to cancel flights to Yemen.

The employees started the strike at six a.m. (0300 GMT) on Wednesday at Yemen's Aden and Sanaa airports but ended it when the airline agreed to grant them a 30 percent increase in cost of living allowances and promised to study other demands.
The airline has faced a series of strikes by various employee groups including pilots and engineers. Yemen Airways has a fleet of 13 planes and flies to 23 destinations in Asia, Africa and Europe.
